articles.summary: Nerdy delivers third quarter revenue in line with guidance and non-GAAP adjusted EBITDA ahead of guidance, improving non-GAAP adjusted EBITDA margin by more than 1,000 basis points year-over-year. Nerdy Inc. (NYSE: NRDY) today announced financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. “Our third-quarter results were in line with expectations, with non-GAAP Adjusted EBITDA improving by $4.5 million year over year and non-GAAP Adjusted EBITDA margin expanding by over 1,000 basis points,” said Chuck Cohn, Founder, Chairman and CEO of Nerdy. “We also made important progress on our product transformation, rolling out a redesigned student experience and advancing new self-service commerce capabilities. Together, these improvements are designed to make it easier for families to get started, deliver more value between tutoring sessions, and create a more efficient, scalable business. articles.title: Nerdy Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
